'''Noren Rurm''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Sullustan/Legends|Sullustan]] [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. [[EV-8D3]], leader of the [[New Droids' Rights Movement]], dealed with him a shipment of [[Blaster rifle/Legends|blaster rifles]]. Rurm was the first casualty of the [[Gavos Droid Revolution]].
